manifest.tokenBudgetRule: per arm, checked between trials; not a ceiling, the trial in flight can exceed it

comparisons.label: visibility (all tools direct)
comparisons.note: same build and text. B makes every tool direct, not only the continuation tools, so this is the effect of an all-direct surface.

comparisons.label: composite: new text + direct-set narrowing
comparisons.note: not the wording effect. C has the new text, and it also narrows the direct set: B makes every tool direct, while C adds only the three continuation tools to the fleet default's direct set. Arm D separates the two.

comparisons.label: wording (all tools direct)
comparisons.note: every tool is direct in both; only the text differs. On the Codex harness D's continuation tools also move into the openclaw_direct namespace.

comparisons.label: placement: direct-set narrowing (new text)
comparisons.note: same build and text; C goes back to the fleet default's direct set plus the three continuation tools. B → D and D → C add up to B → C.

comparisons.label: settled wording (same placement)
comparisons.note: the same fleet-default config and direct-only placement on both, and the settled text on E. On the embedded runtime only the text the model is shown differs (the probe): the three descriptions, the parameter descriptions of continue_work and continue_delegate, and five prompt lines, the delegate's tooling line and the continuation section's wake, self-elected-turn and compaction lines and its sessions_yield caveat. On the Codex harness de55f350 also adds the whole continuation section to the harness prompt, which f9fcd3a5's lacks, so there it is more than wording.

comparisons.label: placement + settled wording
comparisons.note: deploy of de55f350 over ab5a30ea: the continuation tools move from deferred to direct-only and the text becomes the settled one. On the same trials A → B, B → C and C → E add up to it.
